messages.text:
Hi HeliumDeploy,

Maria here, I look after partnerships at Geonode. We pay apps to bundle our opt-in bandwidth sharing SDK. I came across HeliumDeploy and it looks like a great fit: real users, and a tool that's free or close to it.

The way it works is simple. Your users get a clear consent prompt to share their idle bandwidth. Only the ones who say yes count, and they can opt out anytime. You get paid every month for each active user who opted in, and you're never locked in either.

Our partners already earn solid income from this. It sits nicely on top of ad revenue and whatever else you already run, and the whole thing is compliance focused, with a team that monitors how the network is used.

Want me to send over how it works and what partners typically earn? A one-word reply does it. No call, no deck.

Maria P.
Geonode.com
To unsubscribe, please click [here](https://outreach.geonode.com/t/u/····)

Note to the team: This is a vendor pitch, not a customer. No action needed beyond a short decline. Hi Maria, Thanks for reaching out.
